text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

Under the Kawasaki sunset—Wonder Acute put 
on a run filled with passionate 
determination. And then...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah.... Did you all see that? That's 
right. This is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Running like the star! My heart's just 
blazin' up like crazy now!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is this... what running is all about? Is 
this what it means to be alive, I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's so unlike me... And yet...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Nice... I'm exhausted, but... this feels 
wonderful... This radiance is what 
everyone seeks...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Falco-san...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Geez, seriously now...!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That was the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've always thought she was an amazing 
Umamusume. That she'd definitely stand on 
the same stage as me in the future. 
But...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was beyond what I imagined! I never 
thought you'd put on such a dazzling run 
right beside me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume I've been waiting for all 
this time must be...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was you, Acute-san! Thank you so much 
for coming all this way to see me!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Falco-san...

Smart Falcon walked up to Wonder Acute and 
gave her a tight hug. That was...

"It looked like a ceremony welcoming a new 
Umamusume onto the top dirt stage."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, this is the best... Being hugged by 
Falco-san makes all the fatigue from 
overworking just melt away...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if deep down, I wanted to enjoy 
my youth like this too.)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Falu-ko! Falu-ko! Acute! Acute!

The cheers had now completely split the 
venue in two. And then—

text_block_list.name: Boxing Candidates
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
Little lady... that was incredible...! You 
sure packed a mean punch!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
When someone gives it their absolute 
all... they can shine this bright. Even if 
they weren't born a champion.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! Let's burn the young lady's 
current look into our memories!"

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of taking a break today... 
but I reckon I'll do my rehab after all.

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
If I could smile like that too... I'm sure 
my grandchild would be thrilled. Once 
more... once more, with these legs!

That sight was broadcast nationwide—and 
its brilliant shine brightly illuminated 
the deepest recesses of everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks a bunch. This race really 
taught me something.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They say that if you try hard enough, even 
silver can turn into gold.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you were truly shining out there!
Yeah, you were truly shining out there!

text_block_list.text:
There are indeed Umamusume who are born 
inheriting a golden light. However—

"Layering silver upon silver enough times 
can yield a brilliance rivaling gold. 
Today, I have proven that."

However, the problem is—what lies ahead. 
Given how much she pushed herself this 
time... there's no telling what kind of 
toll it will take.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, if possible, I'd love to run with 
Falco-san again next time. She always 
gives me so much energy, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, where should we go for that, I 
wonder?
choice_data_list: Next up is the February Stakes...

text_block_list.text:
"...I paused mid-sentence to think. It's 
true that the GⅠ February Stakes is one of 
the biggest dirt races. However..."

The race is just around the corner, and 
entering would mean running back-to-back. 
That's too cruel for Wonder Acute right 
now. And what's more—

Likewise, since it would mean consecutive 
races for Smart Falcon, she's unlikely to 
enter. In that case, the next GⅠ...
choice_data_list: Let's go with the Kashiwa Kinen in May.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, May... That's still a bit away. Right 
around the Children's Day celebration...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's Children's Day today, so how about 
Falco and I put on a race that'll make the 
kids super happy?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Gotta do my best next time too, huh? I 
really gotta keep trying...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ......*breathes*

A wave of exhaustion must have washed over 
her. To the point she couldn't even stay 
conscious anymore.

I want to help her recover before the next 
race somehow. And so—

I wanted to return Wonder Acute to her 
usual laid-back self, as if nothing had 
ever happened, and let her run the Kashiwa 
Kinen.
